social_accounts_health.name: social_accounts_health
social_accounts_health.value: health is null or health in ('ok', 'warning', 'error')

social_accounts_quota.name: social_accounts_quota
social_accounts_quota.value: ("social_accounts"."quota_used" is null or "social_accounts"."quota_used" >= 0) and ("social_accounts"."quota_total" is null or "social_accounts"."quota_total" >= 0)

notification_settings_quiet.name: notification_settings_quiet
notification_settings_quiet.value:
("notification_settings"."quiet_start" is null) = ("notification_settings"."quiet_end" is null)
          and ("notification_settings"."quiet_start" is null or ("notification_settings"."quiet_start" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and "notification_settings"."quiet_end" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'))
